profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I programmed professionally for the first time without even realizing it. I built an extensive logic driven quality checklist for my department and it was only after I finished that I realized that this giant series of logic gates was essentially a program. 

Since then, I've grown into a senior software engineer and team lead who thrives at the intersection of technical depth and human collaboration. I have a strong background in full-stack development and cloud architecture, and have led high-performing teams to deliver scalable systems, eliminate critical bugs, and drive measurable improvements across infrastructure and user experience.

When I'm not programming, I enjoy cooking cuisines from different countries, stand up comedy, and playing with dogs. I have a deep and abiding fascination with 90s era Nickelodeon and the noble stegosaurus.

positions.title: Software Engineering Lead
positions.description:
- Developed middleware that handled authentication, database transaction capture, and data lake ingestion, successfully integrating an acquired application into the Scholastic platform, and creating a seamless experience for both internal and external users

- Led engineering team by planning development work, organizing production deployments, and mentoring engineers to achieve personal development goals, seeing a large improvement in team performance

- Diagnosed and eliminated critical data integrity bugs, reducing incident volume to zero and implementing automated alerts via Datadog for future regressions 

- Created scalable internal design system components, accelerating frontend development, guaranteeing accessibility, and improving UI consistency across teams

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Trained engineers across all teams on monitoring the platform for anomalous behavior, triaging issues, and identifying any necessary resources, driving down the Mean Time To Resolution by 25% 

- Constructed a Lambda service to import files with tens of thousands of rows of data, format the data, and serve the data to SQS in batches, minimizing the imports' impact on the production database, allowing changes during business hours 

- Analyzed patterns in escalations, and constructed internal tools to provide additional, controlled, functionality to frontline agents, reducing total escalation volume by 50%

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created alerts, dashboards, and synthetics using New Relic to monitor key application health metrics and provide clear, actionable alerts when issues arose
- Investigated emergent issues, identified their root causes, and implemented fixes as rapidly as possible, to minimize customer impact
- Analyzed patterns in escalations, and constructed internal tools to provide additional, controlled, functionality to frontline agents, reducing total escalation volume by 50%

positions.title: Software Engineer Coach
positions.description:
- Performed code reviews and debugging for dozens of students’ projects, ensuring that code quality and structure meets professional standards
- Conducted intensive one-on-one mock interviews to evaluate and improve student coding and communication skills, cultivating both their ability to write effective code and to clearly communicate their thought process
- Instruct students, as groups and individually, in best practices, problem solving, data structures, and algorithms, to prepare them for coding challenges and technical interviews

positions.title: Manager of Quality Control
positions.description:
- Oversee a team of 13 responsible for comprehensive quality review of hundreds of provider applications and updates each day.
- Implement process improvements and new standards to ensure that client quality expectations are achieved.
- Ensure that quality standards are clearly defined and communicated to all within functional area.
- Analyze data to identify and report quality trends and recommend corrective action to senior management.
- Establish accuracy and production standards in accordance with contract driven performance indicators.
- Designed, developed, and implemented an electronic quality control system as a replacement for the existing manual quality control system.
- Performed and coached others in data analysis and conducted root cause analysis.
- Collaborate with production and training teams to identify quality trends and devise strategies for addressing any issues. 
- Guide quality assurance team through the adoption of new systems and standards.
- Produce specifications for improvements to existing software and work with internal software development to ensure successful implementation.

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
- Reviewed workflow processes and reporting to identify potential enhancements.
- Collaborated with department directors to implement enhancements and manage projects. 
- Designed, built, and maintained reports for all functional areas.

positions.title: Quality Management Coordinator
positions.description:
- Oversaw the administering of training to hundreds of staff for the Contact Center of the Connecticut Health Insurance Marketplace. 
- Composed, updated, coordinated, and delivered training to existing staff, management, and the project's client across the Contact Center's sites in four states. 
- Composed training materials for staff based on resolved JIRA tickets. 
- Met with management and other department heads to review the project plan and devise a course of action to ensure that training and document development milestones are met.

positions.title: Quality Assurance/KMS Specialist/Training Lead
positions.description:
- Composed, updated, and delivered training to existing staff. 
- Administered and maintained Sharepoint database used by all Contact Center staff. 
- Evaluated calls, researched and addressed complaints and issues as requested by management. 
- Composed and distributed materials to address Contact Center issues as they arose.

positions.title: Coach
positions.description:
- Demonstrated effective presentations. 
- Worked closely with participants between classes to facilitate learning and application of techniques. 
- Collaborated with instructor and other coaches to tailor lesson plan to the needs of the participants.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Worked as part of the Back to Business grant program. 
- Assisted in the review of disaster relief grants for small businesses. 
- Visited businesses to examine extent of damages and interview business owners.  
- Managed database of grants and kept officers and applicants appraised of the status of applications.

positions.title: Hospital Care Investigator
positions.description:
- Interviewed patients and conducted investigations to determine possible insurance coverage as well as their eligibility for Medicaid. 
- Notified the carriers and completed Medicaid applications on behalf of the patients.

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description:
- Participated in Cornell Prelaw Program. 
- Worked directly under Co-Director Brent Meltzer. 
- Attended numerous hearings regarding eviction proceedings against low income tenants in Brooklyn Landlord Tenant Court. 
- Observed judges to ascertain the views and inclinations of each judge that presided over these cases.

company.name: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai

positions.title: Paid Intern
positions.description:
- Assisted a group of researchers in a long term study to identify genetic contributors to schizophrenia.
- Extracted DNA from blood and saliva samples. 
- Performed PCR, digestion, and sequencing of DNA samples. 
- Compared genetic sequences to identify polymorphisms.

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description:
- Assisted a group of researchers in a long term study to identify genetic contributors to schizophrenia. 
- Extracted DNA from blood and saliva samples. 
- Performed PCR, digestion, and sequencing of DNA samples. 
- Compared genetic sequences to identify polymorphisms.
